name: Audacity
tagline: An easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder. Developed by a group of volunteers as open source.
description: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder. Developed by a group of volunteers as open source.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/audacity:4.0.1@sha256:95644aca4d27e3b830a09ff45e1b8ed6daa61b1d8e340aef1229368bb5c92cca
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
